You are a senior product designer + full-stack web developer. Build a modern, high-credibility personal brand website for a senior executive named Luis F. Romo. The domain will be luisfromo.com. Requirements: clean, modern, “Dan Martell style” (bold hero, high contrast, strong typography, lots of whitespace, scannable sections, big numbers, clear CTAs). Must include a blog with a simple backend CMS I can update 
1) BRANDING (MUST FOLLOW)
Use the following brand system exactly:
Brand keywords: Execution, Excellence, Perseverance, Leadership, Innovation, Integrity, Respect, Energy, Strength, Confidence, Professional.
Colors (hex):
* Primary/hero: #161616 (near-black), #60B7E3 (light blue), #E7E7E7 (light gray), and light shade #A4D6EF
* Accents: #2D2D2D, #01236B (dark blue), #708FBF, light shade #A6B9D7, #FF0000 (red), #ffffff (white) Color usage: predominantly dark/white with blue as primary accent; red used sparingly as an “energy” highlight line or small accent.
Typography:
* Primary: “MADE Future X Medium” for headers (ALL CAPS)
* Body: Montserrat Regular for paragraphs If MADE Future X is not available, use a close Google font fallback for headings (Orbitron or Oxanium) but keep Montserrat for body.
Imagery style:
* Soft-tone, professional stock imagery; cultural diversity; minimalist; occasional “tech / road / future” vibe.
* Use icons sparingly. Keep the site premium, not cluttered.
2) LUIS POSITIONING + CONTENT (USE THIS AS SOURCE OF TRUTH)
Create sections that highlight Luis’s biggest wins with bold numbers and proof points.
Luis F. Romo — Business Executive: Strategy, Growth & Innovation Location: Orlando, Florida Core positioning: Partnership, Business Growth, Execution.
Key roles:
1. Chief of Strategy and New Business Development — VORA VERA LLC (2022–Present): building and executing business plans for a $50M portfolio; supply chain optimization; launched first products/revenues; partnership with Amazon Global Logistics.
2. Founder & CEO — PurpleSun Inc (2012–2022): startup-to-exit healthcare technology company.
    * 20+ global patents & trademarks (US, Canada, Japan, Europe, Australia, China)
    * Built exec leadership team (CFO, CSO, VPs), board and clinical advisory board
    * Full P&L / balance sheet / cashflow
    * Secured $40M term sheet for M&A from strategic partner
    * Completed multimillion-dollar technology sale
    * Secured >$10M in customer contracts; scaled revenues 10x (B2B medical capital equipment)
    * Commercialized complex electromechanical equipment + iOS/Android apps + live mobile communications
    * Helped secure a new global regulatory standard via ASTM E35 committee vote
    * Achieved 65%+ gross margin / COGS targets; ISO 13485 quality management; UL 61010 approvals
Media/Publications: WSJ, CBS News, Newsweek Expert Forum, UL certification coverage, AJIC/J Appl Microbiology papers (include a “Featured In” strip + a Media page).
Education:
* Wharton Executive Business Training (2022–2023)
* Harvard Finance & Accounting (2014–2015)
* MS + BS Biomedical Engineering — Syracuse University (2006–2012)
Languages: English + Spanish (native)
IMPORTANT ADDITION (not in resume; must be included):
* Since March 2025: COO — SWISH XR / “SWISH XR Hooper”
* Statement: “After several months of hard work, I’ve jumped into the world of VR/XR technology and launching the SWISH XR Hooper — first ever basketball simulator gaming system without needing goggles or a headset.”
3) PRIMARY CONVERSION GOAL
This site is primarily a credibility engine + lead router. Add a prominent “Work with Luis” CTA that jumps to a section with 3 solution cards and buttons.
3 solution cards (exact structure): Each card headline must start with: “Do you need help with ___?” Each has 2–3 lines of punchy copy + a button.
A) Do you need help with Execution (Getting the right work done)? Audience: executives + entrepreneurs overwhelmed, overworked, no work-life balance, frustrated, “busy but not progressing”. Offer: Growth Sprint System — task prioritization, complexity scoring, admin integration, calendar control. Button: “Explore Growth Sprint System” → https://growthsprintsystem.com
B) Do you need help with Growing Sales? Offer: Sales Growth Multiplier — ecosystem of inbound/outbound tools, autonomous SDR that calls prospects, qualifies leads, books appointments. Button: “Explore Sales Growth Multiplier” → https://salesgrowthmultiplier.com
C) Do you need help with Content (Authority without the time)? Offer: daily inbox prompt → user answers → repurposed into LinkedIn/X/IG/blog posts automatically. “Barely lift a finger.” Button: “Explore Content Growth Multiplier” → https://contentgrowthmultiplier.com
4) INFORMATION ARCHITECTURE (PAGES)
Create a simple, premium nav:
* Home
* About
* Work (or “Experience”)
* Media
* Blog
* Contact
Home page sections (wireframe order):
1. Sticky header (logo left, nav center/right, CTA button “Work with Luis”).
2. Hero (Dan Martell style):
    * H1: “STRATEGY. GROWTH. EXECUTION.” (ALL CAPS)
    * Subhead: one strong sentence about scaling businesses, innovation, ops excellence.
    * Primary CTA: “Work with Luis” (scroll to solutions)
    * Secondary CTA: “Read the blog”
    * Hero visuals: subtle abstract tech/clean image; keep it minimal.
3. “Proof Bar” (big numbers):
    * 20+ Global patents
    * $10M+ customer contracts
    * 10x revenue growth
    * $40M M&A term sheet
    * $50M portfolio execution
4. “What Luis Does” (3 columns):
    * Strategy & Growth
    * Operational Excellence / Supply Chain
    * Innovation / IP / Commercialization
5. “Featured In” logo strip (simple, monochrome): WSJ, CBS News, Newsweek, UL, etc.
6. “Signature Wins” (big section with 4–6 bold accomplishment blocks):
    * Global IP moat (20+ patents)
    * Startup-to-exit operator
    * Enterprise dealmaker (>$10M contracts)
    * Regulatory standard (ASTM E35)
    * Manufacturing + quality systems (ISO 13485, UL approvals, 65%+ GPM)
    * Logistics + scale partnerships (Amazon global logistics; $50M portfolio)
7. “Current Focus” (SWISH XR):
    * Highlight COO since March 2025
    * Emphasize “basketball simulator without goggles/headset”
    * Include one CTA: “See what I’m building” (link placeholder or section anchor)
8. “Do you need help with ___?” (the 3 solution cards with buttons + small disclaimer “Each program has its own site”)
9. Blog preview (latest 3 posts, “View all posts”)
10. Contact CTA section:
* One sentence + contact form + email link
* Optional Calendly placeholder button
About page:
* 2-column layout: story + values (brand keywords)
* Include education, languages, leadership style, and a “how I work” mini-section.
Work/Experience page:
* Timeline style
* VORA VERA section
* PurpleSun deep dive with metrics
* Skills grid (strategy, supply chain, manufacturing, investments, commercialization, M&A, R&D, IP, finance, resource planning)
Media page:
* List links from resume (WSJ, CBS, Newsweek, UL, papers)
* Provide card layout with title, outlet, and “Read” link
Blog page:
* Blog index + categories/tags
* Post template with reading time, share buttons, author box
* SEO-ready
Contact page:
* Simple form + email + social links (LinkedIn at minimum)
* Keep it clean
5) TECH STACK + IMPLEMENTATION (NETLIFY + GITHUB + BLOG CMS)
Build as a static site with a modern framework and markdown blogging: Option A (preferred): Astro + MD/MDX for blog (fast and simple on Netlify) Option B: Next.js (if you must) Use TailwindCSS for styling. Implement Decap CMS (Netlify CMS) for editing blog posts:
* Create /admin/ route with config.yml
* Store posts in /src/content/blog/ (or equivalent)
* Include instructions in README for connecting GitHub + Netlify Identity + Git Gateway so I can log in and add posts.
Also include:
* Clean URL routes (/blog/my-post)
* RSS feed
* Sitemap
* SEO meta tags + OpenGraph + Twitter cards
* JSON-LD schema for Person and BlogPosting
* Accessibility (contrast, keyboard nav)
* Performance (lazy-load images)
6) DELIVERABLES (WHAT YOU OUTPUT)
Output: A) A clear wireframe outline for each page (sections, purpose, key copy) B) Final copy (headlines + paragraphs) for Home, About, Experience, and the 3 solution cards C) The full project file structure D) All key code files necessary to run locally and deploy on Netlify, including:
* package.json
* astro/next config
* tailwind config
* main layout + components
* blog index + post template
* Decap CMS files: /public/admin/index.html and /public/admin/config.yml
* sample blog posts (2) relevant to Luis’s expertise (strategy/execution, scaling operations, innovation/IP)
* README with setup steps (Netlify deploy, enable Identity, Git Gateway, CMS login) E) Provide placeholders for: logo assets path, favicon, Luis headshot, LinkedIn URL, Calendly link.
7) TONE / COPY STYLE
Voice: confident, direct, high-agency, executive. Short sentences. Scannable. Use “proof-first” writing with metrics. No fluff. No hype. Premium.
Now generate the complete solution.
